settings.server_id.label: Server ID
settings.server_id.description: Optional Speedtest server ID. Find IDs with List servers.
settings.show_provider.label: Show ISP and IP information
settings.show_provider.description: Include the ISP and IP line in full test output.
settings.save_history.label: Save test history
settings.save_history.description: Append results to the monthly log and history.csv.
settings.history_dir.label: History folder
settings.history_dir.description: Optional folder. Leave blank to use the script default under Documents/SpeedTest.
settings.watch_interval.label: Watch interval (minutes)
settings.watch_interval.description: How often the background watch performs a test.
settings.widget.glyph.label: Bar icon
settings.widget.glyph.description: Choose the icon shown by the SpeedTest bar widget.
settings.widget.show_label.label: Show bar label
settings.widget.show_label.description: Show or hide the SpeedTest text beside the icon.
settings.widget.show_result.label: Show temporary result in bar
settings.widget.show_result.description: Show download and upload after each test even when the normal label is hidden, then return to the previous state.
settings.widget.result_duration.label: Bar result duration (seconds)
settings.widget.result_duration.descript: How long the test summary stays visible before it disappears.
